_: It.21: an NPC that physically FOLLOWS THE PLAYER via the Follow procedure template (Skyrim.esm:0x019B2C). Slot 0 'Target to Follow' = PackageTargetSpecificReference to the player (0x000014) — exactly what every vanilla 'FollowsPlayer' package emits; the build defaults follow.target to the player when omitted. This is the raw tag-along MOVEMENT only (not a full follower with dialogue/hire — that needs a managing quest + follow faction). Citizenship recipe (crimeFaction + town faction + unique) is included so she can traverse the inn door / city gates when the player leads her cross-cell (It.16c lesson). Placed in the Sleeping Giant Inn at the It.16b-confirmed spawn; `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, wait ~30-90s cold-start, then walk around / out the door — she should trail you, closing to ~128 units and not lagging past ~256.

packages._: Follow template. target omitted ⇒ defaults to the player (Skyrim.esm:0x000014). minRadius/maxRadius are how close she closes in vs. how far she may lag. accompany=true = walk WITH the player rather than just chase.

placements._: Sleeping Giant Inn at the It.16b-confirmed walkable spawn (0,0,0). Player coc's in, finds her, then leads her around / out the door.
